assets.name: OnboardingAirmailEnvelopeBack
assets.role: rear open-envelope liner with two broad diagonal kraft side wings, narrow striped outer rails, and a transparent centre behind the onboarding state card; never a full rectangle or opaque central V
assets.source: built-in image generation using the founder-approved onboarding direction as the sole geometry and material reference
assets.transform: flat chroma-key removal, alpha bounding-box crop, deterministic 1x/2x/3x resampling; section-level layer only, never a whole-screen background

assets.name: OnboardingAirmailEnvelopeBackV2
assets.role: complete rear open-envelope liner with two broad kraft side wings, narrow striped outer rails, and one continuous kraft centre behind the onboarding state card
assets.source: built-in image generation using the previous rear-side-wing asset as edit target and the founder-approved onboarding direction as construction reference
assets.transform: flat chroma-key removal with the installed imagegen helper, alpha bounding-box measurement, transparent-padded 370:220 crop, deterministic 1x/2x/3x Lanczos resampling

assets.name: OnboardingEnvelopeFront
assets.role: blank kraft front pocket for the onboarding open-envelope shell; preserves the raised shoulders, shallow centre point, stitching, and left postal cancellation
assets.source: built-in image edit using the founder-approved onboarding direction as the sole geometry and material reference
assets.transform: flat chroma-key removal, alpha bounding-box crop, deterministic 1x/2x/3x resampling

assets.name: OnboardingEnvelopeFrontV2
assets.role: blank kraft front pocket with one broad continuous mouth, raised shoulders, stitched perimeter, and left postal cancellation; the shared mouth replaces the detached centre notch without adding another runtime layer
assets.source: deterministic composite of the founder-approved owned SavesEnvelope mouth and the existing owned OnboardingEnvelopeFront body
assets.transform: preserve the SavesEnvelope upper 90 px silhouette and mouth texture, remove its wax-seal region with mirrored owned kraft texture, blend into the existing onboarding pocket body over 30 px, and emit deterministic 1x/2x/3x RGBA outputs
